card.name: Places where 'step' is the next word
card.fires_on: Text just before a spot where 'step' or 'steps' could come next, such as the 'st' or 'ste' of sidestep, STEP, or STEADY, or a word before '-step'. It also fires on a few other word pieces that begin with 'ste'.

modes.label: Broken-up 'step' words
modes.description: The pole fires on the first piece of a word that continues into step, such as sidestep or capitalised STEPS.

modes.label: Before '-step' or 'steps'
modes.description: The pole fires on a word that leads into step or steps in a multi-part process.

modes.label: Capitalised instruction words
modes.description: The pole fires on a piece of an all-caps word beginning with STE in instructions or labels.
